name: M6.ActualCounts.boundary_card
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualCounts.BP), a.degree < (N : WithBot ℕ) → b.degree < (N : WithBot ℕ) → (M6.Spaces.boundaryWords N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b)).card = 2^(N-(M6.ActualCounts.f N a b))
context:
theorem M6.ActualCounts.f_le_order : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualCounts.BP), M6.ActualCounts.f N a b ≤ N := by
  intro N inst a b
  change (M6.Cyclic.signature a b (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)).natDegree ≤ N
  have hm := M6.Coordinates.modulus_monic_degree N
  have hd := (M6.Cyclic.signature_divides a b (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)).2.2
  simpa only [hm.2] using Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hd hm.1.ne_zero
queries: natural powers cancellation finite set cardinality
guidance: Use actual input_normalization and Spaces.dual_boundary_card. Rewrite2^N as2^f*2^(N-f) by f_le_order and pow_add, cancel the positive factor2^f. Final hypotheses remain only the actual degree bounds. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
